Group rides in Columbus, OH

4 recurring group rides around Columbus, OH: 3 road, 2 social, 1 mixed. 2 roll on weeknights, 1 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Thursday Night Central Columbus & Metro Parks Ride in Columbus — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Cafe Hero Sunday Ride runs a/B/C pace groups on 2nd Sundays; looser 'decaffeinated' rides other weeks.
